answer: To enroll, publish a fresh echo/lantern/mirror TXT challenge under a newly registered DNSSEC-signed domain. An independent resolver verifies the signature chain and nonce; the registry consumes the domain and registrant fingerprints, rejecting duplicates, stale proofs or invalid signatures. Proposed one-year registration and validation fee: 1.80 per key, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays 1.80 once; 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 domains and cost 1,800 (1,000 × 1.80). Limitation: a determined owner can buy many domains, and access or prices vary.
